mapper.select: SELECT rule_id,scene_id,violation_type,rule_description,keywords_json,severity,enabled FROM zentide_governance_rule WHERE enabled=1 ORDER BY rule_id
SELECT rule_id,scene_id,violation_type,rule_description,keywords_json,severity,enabled,updated_at FROM zentide_governance_rule ORDER BY enabled DESC,updated_at DESC,rule_id DESC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO zentide_governance_result(result_id,content_id,scene_id,risk_level,suggested_action,confidence,payload_json) VALUES(#{resultId},#{contentId},#{sceneId},#{riskLevel},#{suggestedAction},#{confidence},#{payloadJson}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE risk_level=VALUES(risk_level),suggested_action=VALUES(suggested_action),confidence=VALUES(confidence),payload_json=VALUES(payload_json)
mapper.select: SELECT r.payload_json FROM zentide_governance_result r WHERE r.risk_level<>'low' AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM zentide_moderation_feedback f WHERE f.agent_result_id=r.result_id) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM zentide_governance_result newer WHERE newer.content_id=r.content_id AND newer.created_at>r.created_at) ORDER BY r.created_at DESC LIMIT #{limit}
